title: Company summary frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of company-profile/<company_id>/summary.md, the human-readable report the report-writer regenerates from details.json, the SDLC policy and metastore, vendors, the ledger, initiatives and suggestions. Like every Maxwell document it carries a nested provenance block (YAML mapping) so scripts collect provenance uniformly; provenance.inputsHash records the hash of the source files. Quote timestamps in YAML so they stay strings

companyId.description: Slug of the company; must equal the company-profile/<company_id> folder name

title.description: Report title shown as the document heading

version.description: Semantic version of the report; bump minor on each regeneration and major when the section set changes

sections.description: Sections present in the body, in document order; each maps to a level-2 heading the report-writer produces. risks and incidents carry the regulator reporting clocks from the ledger; data-flows summarises sdlc/metastore.json

provenance.description: Who generated the report and from what. inputsHash is required: sha256 over the concatenated bytes of the source files in this exact order: details.json, sdlc/policy.json, sdlc/metastore.json (skipped when absent), vendors/*.json sorted by file name, soc/main.jsonl, change_management/master.json, change_management/initiatives/*/timeline.json sorted by initiative id, suggestions/master.json. An unchanged hash means the report is current

inputsHash.description: sha256 over the ordered source files listed above
